findings.message: Insecure path boundary check (CWE-22): 'os.path.commonprefix' (like raw 'str.startswith') compares paths character-by-character rather than by directory segments, allowing sibling-prefix Path Traversal bypasses (e.g. '/app/static' matching '/app/static_disallowed'). Use path-segment-aware 'os.path.commonpath([resolved_target, resolved_base]) == resolved_base' instead.
